entries.notes: Lilith historical layers (Shax t598u), kept apart: Mesopotamian lilītu/ardat-lilī; Isaiah 34:14 (only HB occurrence, not Genesis); late antique incantation bowls; Alphabet of Ben Sira (8th-10th c., first wife as midrash on Gen 1:27 vs Gen 2); Isaac ha-Kohen and the Zohar pair her with Samael.
